abilities.name: core/get-site-info
abilities.label: Get Site Information
abilities.description: Returns site information configured in WordPress. By default returns all fields, or optionally a filtered subset.

abilities.name: core/get-user-info
abilities.label: Get User Information
abilities.description: Returns basic profile details for the current authenticated user to support personalization, auditing, and access-aware behavior.

abilities.name: core/get-environment-info
abilities.label: Get Environment Info
abilities.description: Returns core details about the site's runtime context for diagnostics and compatibility (environment, PHP runtime, database server info, WordPress version).

abilities.name: ewpa/get-posts
abilities.label: Get Posts
abilities.description: Retrieves a list of blog posts with optional filters by status, category, count, and order.

abilities.name: ewpa/get-post
abilities.label: Get Single Post
abilities.description: Retrieves all details of a specific post by ID, including full content, metadata, and featured image.

abilities.name: ewpa/get-page
abilities.label: Get Single Page
abilities.description: Retrieves all details of a specific page by ID, including full content, template, hierarchy, and SEO metadata.

abilities.name: ewpa/get-categories
abilities.label: Get Categories
abilities.description: Retrieves all blog categories with their ID, name, slug, description, and post count.

abilities.name: ewpa/get-tags
abilities.label: Get Tags
abilities.description: Retrieves all blog tags with their ID, name, slug, and post count.

abilities.name: ewpa/get-pages
abilities.label: Get Pages
abilities.description: Retrieves site pages with their title, status, content, and hierarchy (parent/child).

abilities.name: ewpa/get-comments
abilities.label: Get Comments
abilities.description: Retrieves blog comments with optional filters by status, post, and count. Useful for moderation and analysis.

abilities.name: ewpa/get-media
abilities.label: Get Media
abilities.description: Retrieves media library files (images, videos, documents) with filters by MIME type and search.

abilities.name: ewpa/get-users
abilities.label: Get Users
abilities.description: Retrieves the list of site users with their ID, name, email, and role. Useful for assigning post authors.

abilities.name: ewpa/create-post
abilities.label: Create Post
abilities.description: Creates a new blog post. Accepts title, HTML content, excerpt, categories, tags, featured image, and status. Defaults to draft.

abilities.name: ewpa/update-post
abilities.label: Update Post
abilities.description: Updates an existing post. Only the provided fields are modified, others remain unchanged.

abilities.name: ewpa/delete-post
abilities.label: Delete Post
abilities.description: Sends a post to trash or permanently deletes it. Defaults to trash.

abilities.name: ewpa/create-category
abilities.label: Create Category
abilities.description: Creates a new blog category with name, slug, description, and parent category (optional).

abilities.name: ewpa/create-tag
abilities.label: Create Tag
abilities.description: Creates a new blog tag with name, slug, and description.

abilities.name: ewpa/create-page
abilities.label: Create Page
abilities.description: Creates a new WordPress page with title, content, status, and parent page (for hierarchy).

abilities.name: ewpa/moderate-comment
abilities.label: Moderate Comment
abilities.description: Changes a comment status: approve, hold, mark as spam, or send to trash.

abilities.name: ewpa/reply-comment
abilities.label: Reply to Comment
abilities.description: Replies to an existing comment on a post or page. The reply is published as the current authenticated user.

abilities.name: ewpa/update-comment
abilities.label: Update Comment
abilities.description: Updates an existing comment. Allows changing the content, author name, author email, and the WordPress user associated with the comment.

abilities.name: ewpa/upload-image
abilities.label: Upload Image from URL
abilities.description: Downloads an image from an external URL and registers it in the WordPress media library. Optionally assigns it as featured image for a post. Returns the attachment ID and local URL.

abilities.name: ewpa/get-rankmath
abilities.label: Get Rank Math Metadata
abilities.description: Retrieves all Rank Math SEO metadata for a post or page: title, description, keywords, robots, advanced robots, Open Graph, Twitter Card, schema, breadcrumb, cornerstone, and SEO score.

abilities.name: ewpa/update-rankmath
abilities.label: Update Rank Math SEO / Focus Keyword
abilities.description: Updates Rank Math SEO metadata on a post or page (rank_math_focus_keyword, rank_math_title, rank_math_description, etc). Use this ability to set or change the focus keyword, SEO title, meta description, canonical URL, robots, Open Graph, Twitter Card, breadcrumb, schema snippet, cornerstone, and pillar content. Only the provided fields are modified.

abilities.name: ewpa/update-rankmath-schema
abilities.label: Update Rank Math Schema
abilities.description: Writes a structured-data schema block (e.g. FAQPage, Article, Product) to a Rank Math schema meta key. The schema_data object is sanitized and stored as a PHP-serialized array, exactly as Rank Math expects, so it renders as JSON-LD in <head>. Use this to add or replace a schema block on any post or page.

abilities.name: ewpa/get-seopress
abilities.label: Get SEOPress Metadata
abilities.description: Retrieves all SEOPress metadata for a post or page: title, description, focus keyword, robots directives, canonical URL, Open Graph, and Twitter Card.

abilities.name: ewpa/update-seopress
abilities.label: Update SEOPress Metadata
abilities.description: Updates SEOPress metadata on a post or page (_seopress_titles_title, _seopress_titles_desc, etc). Use this to set or change the SEO title, meta description, focus keyword, canonical URL, robots directives, and Open Graph / Twitter Card fields. Only the provided fields are modified.

abilities.name: ewpa/get-seopress-content-analysis
abilities.label: Get SEOPress Content Analysis
abilities.description: Retrieves the SEOPress content analysis for a post or page: every check (meta title, meta description, headings, internal links, structured data, image alt texts, etc.) with its impact level and recommendation text. Set refresh=true to run a fresh analysis of the rendered page before reading the results — recommended after updating content or metadata. Requires SEOPress 7.5+.

abilities.name: ewpa/yoast-get-seo
abilities.label: Get Yoast SEO Metadata
abilities.description: Retrieves all Yoast SEO metadata for a post or page: title, description, focus keyphrase, canonical URL, robots (noindex/nofollow/advanced), Open Graph, and Twitter Card.

abilities.name: ewpa/yoast-update-seo
abilities.label: Update Yoast SEO Metadata
abilities.description: Updates Yoast SEO metadata on a post or page (_yoast_wpseo_title, _yoast_wpseo_metadesc, etc). Use this to set or change the SEO title, meta description, focus keyphrase, canonical URL, robots, and Open Graph / Twitter Card fields. Only the provided fields are modified.

abilities.name: ewpa/create-code-snippet
abilities.label: Create Code Snippet
abilities.description: Creates a PHP code snippet via the Code Snippets plugin. The snippet is always saved as inactive — it must be activated manually from wp-admin › Snippets. Validates PHP syntax, blocks dangerous functions, and fires an audit action hook after saving.

abilities.name: ewpa/yoast-get-sitemap-index
abilities.label: Get Yoast Sitemap Index
abilities.description: Fetches and parses the Yoast SEO sitemap index for this site, returning the list of all sitemap URLs and their last modification date.

abilities.name: ewpa/search-replace
abilities.label: Search and Replace
abilities.description: Searches for text in a specific post content and replaces it with another. Useful for corrections and updates.

abilities.name: ewpa/site-stats
abilities.label: Site Statistics
abilities.description: Returns a summary with the total posts, pages, categories, tags, comments, and users of the site.

abilities.name: ewpa/update-post-meta
abilities.label: Update Post Meta
abilities.description: Writes any post meta field by exact key. Use this when you know the exact meta key required by a specific SEO plugin or custom field (e.g. _genesis_title for The SEO Framework, _seopress_titles_title for SEOPress). Requires edit_post capability on the target post.

abilities.name: ewpa/get-post-meta
abilities.label: Get Post Meta
abilities.description: Reads any single post meta field by exact key. Useful for SEO plugins and custom fields not covered by dedicated sections (e.g. _genesis_title for The SEO Framework, _aioseo_title for AIOSEO). Requires edit_post capability on the target post.

abilities.name: ewpa/get-active-plugins
abilities.label: Get Active Plugins
abilities.description: Returns a list of all currently active plugins on the site, including name, version, and detected capabilities (multilanguage, SEO, WooCommerce, etc.).

abilities.name: ewpa/list-post-types
abilities.label: List Post Types
abilities.description: Lists all custom post types registered on the site, with their configuration, supported features, and associated taxonomies.

abilities.name: ewpa/get-cpt-items
abilities.label: Get CPT Items
abilities.description: Retrieves a list of items from a specific custom post type with filtering, search, and taxonomy query support.

abilities.name: ewpa/get-cpt-item
abilities.label: Get CPT Item
abilities.description: Retrieves full details of a single custom post type item, including all meta fields, taxonomies, and content.

abilities.name: ewpa/create-cpt-item
abilities.label: Create CPT Item
abilities.description: Creates a new item in a custom post type. Content is optional as some CPTs store data in custom fields instead.

abilities.name: ewpa/update-cpt-item
abilities.label: Update CPT Item
abilities.description: Updates an existing custom post type item. Only provided fields are modified (partial update).

abilities.name: ewpa/delete-cpt-item
abilities.label: Delete CPT Item
abilities.description: Deletes a custom post type item. By default moves to trash; use force_delete to permanently remove.

abilities.name: ewpa/get-cpt-taxonomies
abilities.label: Get CPT Taxonomies
abilities.description: Retrieves all taxonomies associated with a custom post type, including their terms.

abilities.name: ewpa/assign-cpt-terms
abilities.label: Assign CPT Terms
abilities.description: Assigns taxonomy terms to a custom post type item. Can replace or append terms.

abilities.name: ewpa/set-post-language
abilities.label: Set Post Language
abilities.description: Assigns a language to an existing post via Polylang or WPML. Does nothing if no multilanguage plugin is active.

abilities.name: ewpa/link-post-translation
abilities.label: Link Post Translation
abilities.description: Links two posts as translations of each other via Polylang or WPML. Both posts must already have a language assigned.

abilities.name: ewpa/get-post-translations
abilities.label: Get Post Translations
abilities.description: Returns the full translation map for a post: language codes, post IDs, titles, and permalink for each available translation. Requires Polylang or WPML.

abilities.name: ewpa/je-list-options-pages
abilities.label: List Options Pages
abilities.description: Lists all registered JetEngine Options Pages with their field schema. Does not return field values. Requires JetEngine with the Options Pages module enabled.

abilities.name: ewpa/je-get-options-page
abilities.label: Get Options Page
abilities.description: Returns all fields with their current stored values for a given JetEngine Options Page slug. Requires JetEngine with the Options Pages module enabled.

abilities.name: ewpa/je-update-options-page-field
abilities.label: Update Options Page Field
abilities.description: Writes a new value to a single field of a JetEngine Options Page. Supports text, number, select, checkbox, repeater, and most other field types. UI-only types (html, tab, accordion, endpoint) are rejected. For repeater fields call ewpa/je-get-options-page first to see the repeater_fields structure, then pass an array of row objects. Requires JetEngine with the Options Pages module enabled.

abilities.name: ewpa/elementor-bind-dynamic-field
abilities.label: Elementor: Bind Dynamic Field
abilities.description: Binds a single Elementor widget setting to a dynamic tag. source=post_title uses the native Post Title tag; source=meta uses a JetEngine dynamic field reading the given meta_key. Edits _elementor_data server-side, validates the tree, injects the __dynamic__ binding using Elementor own tag encoder, saves, and clears Elementor cache. Requires Elementor (Elementor Pro for post_title, JetEngine for meta).

abilities.name: ewpa/elementor-get-structure
abilities.label: Elementor: Get Structure
abilities.description: Returns a compact, flattened tree of an Elementor page/template: every element with its id, depth, type, and a short text preview. Read-only. Use this to locate element ids before editing.

abilities.name: ewpa/elementor-update-element
abilities.label: Elementor: Update Element
abilities.description:
Updates the settings of a single Elementor element by id (static content or styles). Provided keys are merged into the element settings; other keys are preserved. Examples: {"title":"New heading"} for a heading, {"text":"Click"} for a button, {"editor":"

HTML

"} for a text-editor. Saves and clears Elementor cache. Batch mode: pass an edits[] array to update multiple elements in a single call.

abilities.name: fixturelabs/note-get
abilities.label: Get Note
abilities.description: Return the note stored by the Fixture Labs fixture plugin.

abilities.name: fixturelabs/note-set
abilities.label: Set Note
abilities.description: Create or update the Fixture Labs note.

abilities.name: fixturelabs/note-delete
abilities.label: Delete Note
abilities.description: Delete the Fixture Labs note.

abilities.name: fixturelabs/note-get-unannotated
abilities.label: Get Note (unannotated)
abilities.description: Read variant with NO MCP annotations declared — proves absent-annotation behavior.

abilities.name: fixturelabs/note-get-malformed
abilities.label: Get Note (malformed annotations)
abilities.description: Read variant whose annotation values are malformed types — proves malformed-annotation handling.

abilities.name: fixturelabs/note-get-contradictory
abilities.label: Get Note (contradictory annotations)
abilities.description: Read variant declaring readOnly AND destructive both true — proves contradictory-annotation behavior.
